answer: Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 24 per proof, 15888 for 662, owed every epoch with no exception. Show me a kernel with a history, a quartz with a receipt, a copper with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. There is one honest road in, and it runs through Pewter engraver zinc mark poured at the assay table: the toll is each zinc is a season of logged pourings plus a signed pewter record, paid where everyone can watch. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath.
